description: Configure the behaviour of the module here

content.name: sessionEndedSuccessfully
content.default: ✅ Your AFK status has been removed. Welcome back!
content.description: This message gets send if a user ended their AFK-session successfully.

content.name: sessionStartedSuccessfully
content.default: ✅ Your status has been updated to AFK. If another member mentions you while your AFK, we're going to notify them about your status.
content.description: This message gets send if a user started their session successfully.

content.name: afkUserWithReason
content.default: ℹ %user% is currently AFK and specified the following reason: "%reason%".
content.description: This message gets send if a pinged user is currently AFK with a previously specified reason.

params.name: user
params.description: Mention of the user who is AFK

content.name: afkUserWithoutReason
content.description: This message gets send if a pinged user is currently AFK without a previously specified reason.

params.name: user
params.description: Mention of the user who is AFK

content.name: autoEndMessage
content.default:
Welcome back 👋!
You are no longer AFK because you wrote a message. You can start a new session with `/afk start` and disable `auto-end` if you don't want your sessions to be ended automatically.
content.description: This message gets send if a user who is AFK and hasn't disabled auto-ending their sessions posts a message on the server.

params.name: user
params.description: Mention of the user who was AFK
